notes.title: Daemonium Rewired
notes.content: [h1]Key Features Added[/h1][olist][*][p][b]Gamepad Support[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Control Hints Panel[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Settings Menu Upgrade[/b][/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]The highlight of this update is the addition of [b]full gamepad support[/b] across all of Daemonium’s gameplay and UI features.[/p][p]To complement this, the [b]settings menu[/b] has received an upgrade. Some options have been moved into a new [i]General[/i] tab, while the [i]Controls[/i] tab has been expanded to support new features.[/p][p]The [b]key rebinds[/b] section has also been updated to include gamepad rebinds, which now support [b]multi-key bindings[/b].[/p][p]Daemonium now supports [b]multiple types of gamepads[/b], and when one is connected, the in-game binding names will automatically update to match the specific controller. If no controller is connected, the game will display [b]generic names[/b] instead (as shown in the screenshot below).[/p][p]Additionally, I’ve added [b]new sensitivity sliders[/b] for the gamepad sticks.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43994772/260fa201d2885e23a5df525a0b8e2d51465c1f7c.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]One common frustration I’ve noticed when watching streamers play Daemonium is that the game has a lot of unique controls, which can sometimes be hard to remember.[/p][p]To address this, I’ve introduced a new [b]quality-of-life feature[/b]: the [b]Control Hints Panel[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43994772/137dfde1c9a5a864f588dddc8fe669b2b733e4e6.png"][/img][/p][p]This panel is enabled by default and displays Mouse/Keyboard bindings, but it can be switched to Gamepad mode or turned off entirely. Like the keybinds menu, the hints dynamically adjust to the type of gamepad you’re using.[/p][p]The hints are [b]context-sensitive[/b], showing only the controls relevant to what the player is currently doing. They don’t display every command (like sprint), but instead focus on actions the game predicts the player may want to perform.[/p][p]For example:[/p][list][*][p]Looking at a door while standing next to it will display the button to grab it.[/p][/*][*][p]Holding equipment will show the controls for using it.[/p][/*][*][p]Standing at the CCTV monitor will bring up the relevant controls.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]This update also includes a number of [b]minor patches[/b], listed below:[/p][olist][*][p]Exposure in lobby scene slightly reduced[/p][/*][*][p]Localisation of UI text has had some optimisations for text that periodically localises.[/p][/*][*][p]Exorcism book moved to the left to make room for gamepad speech alternatives.[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Localisation Update
notes.content:
I am thrilled to announce that Daemonium is now localized into 13 new languages, making it more accessible than ever. This update includes text and UI localisation only, allowing players around the world to experience the horror in their native language.
The language can be selected from the new dropdown at the top of the settings menu.

Newly supported languages:

Spanish (ES)
French (FR)
Portuguese (PT)
German (DE)
Italian (IT)
Irish (GA)
Chinese (Traditional) (ZH-HK)
Chinese (Simplified) (ZH-CN)
Japanese (JA)
Russian (RU)
Hebrew (HE)
Korean (KR)
Greek (GR)

Please note: all voice detection/audio features in Daemonium remain English-only at this time. Voice commands will continue to require English input to function correctly.


Also added in this release are the following minor updates:
1) Added text prompts to the game's tutorial to support the localisation update. This will enable players who don't understand the English audio instructions to complete the tutorial using written instructions.
2) Lowered demon death sound effect at the end of an Exorcism.

notes.title: Daemonium Exorcism Update
notes.content:
[b]Daemonium receives its first major Early Access update, introducing exorcisms—high-risk, high-reward rituals performed in the demon realm.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43994772/8f1fbcf802e72b7b8ffd6947a71278150fb879e2.png[/img]
Players are highly rewarded for completing an exorcism.
Mistakes reset the exorcism and trigger an immediate hunt.
The demon can hunt during the exorcism, forcing players to survive while performing the ritual.


[b][h2]New Main Objective: Exorcism[/h2][/b]
Upon entering the demon's home players can now perform an exorcism to banish the demon completely.
Follow the instructions in the guidebook if needed or complete the newly updated and fully voice-acted tutorial from the main menu.

[h3]How to complete an Exorcism:[/h3]
Completing an exorcism will make it impossible to retrieve the possessed item.
For maximum money and XP, collect the possessed item in the demon home before completing an exorcism.

There is a new tool chest at the back of the van that will open when the demon home opens.
This chest contains the Thurible and Exorcism Book, both are new tools used in exorcisms.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43994772/d0b20525df645a98b8b7e026b569f897b0eb7ea1.png[/img]

The exorcism/ritual site will always be located near the possessed item.
Players can use the sound gun to detect demon a heartbeat or find normal evidence to locate the general area of the exorcism site.
Players must spread incense with the Thurible for 2 seconds in the vicinity of the site to reveal it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43994772/04c651e198e85833f85faa273302223be191f024.png[/img]

Next, a candle needs to be lit in/near the site to start the exorcism.
This will destroy the demon's heart and raise the Symbol Stone.
The symbol players need to draw on the stone is revealed in the Exorcism book, as well as appearing above the flames of the Altar when correct evidence is submitted.
Interact with the stone, draw, and submit the symbol.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43994772/e54e4f0d8382d8f6389c5bf1722569817d77f064.png[/img]
If the correct symbol is drawn it will appear on the stone.
The stone will then destroy and pull the demon itself into the exorcism site.

Players then need to read the correct exorcism prayer from the Exorcism Book that corresponds to the Exorcism Symbol, of which there are five.
Reading the correct prayer will kill the demon.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43994772/bf67daae443a22c329b8a2b0c72c35a871855ead.png[/img]
No more evidence or possessed items can be collected once the demon is banished.
There will also be no more paranormal activity or events.

Making a mistake at any stage during an exorcism like entering the wrong symbol or saying the wrong prayer will reset the exorcism to the start and trigger a hunt immediately.
Players will need to relight the candle to start again after the hunt.

The demon can also initiate hunts as normal while exorcisms are taking place. This will also reset the exorcism.

[b][h2]Additional minor changes/bug fixes are listed below[/h2][/b]

[b][h3]Minor:[/h3][/b]
1) Fixed demon and enemy vision bug when detecting players.
2) Changed some UI sounds and added some.
3) Added more ghost event sound effects.
4) Fixed a visual bug where the van's registration plate was being rendered after objects in front of it.
5) Added new possessed item models.
6) Fixed interaction inconsistency bug with Altar.
7) Fixed a bug with shoulder lamps not syncing position before clients approach a portal.
8) Fixed a bug preventing mimics from speaking on clients.
9) Added slight pitch variance to repeated sound effects.
10) Renamed use equipment keybind so it's clearer that it's used for the camera and lighter activation.
11) Fixed guidebook texture quality for exorcism pages
12) New default and interact reticles.
13) Changed how item levitation looks.
14) There are now 3 randomly chosen personal objectives per round instead of the same 5 every round.
15) Fixed a bug with loadout configurations after adding the Thurible.
16) Fixed visual bug with exorcisms that made the demon visible before the demon phase.
17) Added new tutorial voice acting for the exorcisms.
18) Added the symbol players draw to both sides of the ritual stone instead of just one.
19) Fixed the exorcism book bug where it was rendered after anything else.
20) Fixed shoulder lamp position bug that had a chance to displace the shoulder lamp of other players.
21) Fixed visual bug with exorcisms that made the demon visible before the demon phase.
22) Replaced temporary tutorial voice lines with voice-acted lines.
23) Added the symbol players draw to both sides of the ritual stone instead of just one.
24) Fixed Exorcism book symbol and text textures showing through players.
25) Fixed shoulder lamp being missing from other players sometimes.
26) Fixed shoulder lights for portals sync bug.
27) Fixed player body position sync bug on startup.
28) Made circus spotlights invisible.
29) Removed some floating leaves from Starved Forest.
30) Fixed the van engine sound when leaving a match.


[b][h3]Balancing:[/h3][/b]
1) Made hunts less likely overall.
2) Added a Backpack and SoundGun to the tutorial's equipment.
3) Increased levitation event from 8 seconds to 30 seconds.
4) Increased chance of any event happening and decreased chance of demon anger increase from events.
5) Reduced the time it takes the Thurible to activate the ritual site by 1 second.
6) Increased the change of the levitation and demon visible ghost events by 300% because they are events associated with personal objectives.
    This gives players a much better chance of being able to do them.
7) Increased demon visible event duration to 6 seconds from 3.
8) Increased levitation event from 8 seconds to 30 seconds.
9) Increased chance of event happening but decreased chance of demon anger increase from events.
10) Reduced the time it takes the Thurible to activate the ritual site by 1 second
11) Increased the chance of the levitation and demon visible ghost events by 300% because they are events associated with personal objectives. This gives players a much better chance of being able to do them. 
12) Increased demon visible event duration to 6 seconds from 3 seconds.


[i]Got ideas, suggestions, constructive criticisms, or thoughts on this update or the game in general? Join Daemonium's Discord and let me know! Many of the changes in this update—including the new exorcism mechanics—came directly from community feedback. Your input helps shape the future of Daemonium, so don’t be shy![/i]

notes.title: Patch 63 - build ea0.375
notes.content:
Patch 63 - build ea0.375 Notes:
Default and Experimental branch

Notable:
1) Added character voices for character selection intros, radio, and prayerbook speech alternatives.
2) Fixed in match proximity voice chat that has been broken since the network code upgrade which had incompatibilities with the voice chat system. Upgraded to newest version of the voice chat package and reintegrated it from scratch.

Minor:
1) Fixed door permalock when item is collected during a hunt.
2) Added +1 to UI in loadouts to show items that come for free in the lobbies.
3) Made lobby code copy-able.
4) Hid lobby code by default.
5) Fixed Compass spinning everywhere in some demon homes
6) Fixed crucifix blocking van interactions.
7) Spectral was broken in multiple ways. Fixed a few bugs with it so should be more reliable now for evidence and photo evidence.
8) Fixed a bug where colliders associated with the portals were blocking the camera from capturing photos. This affected all photo types.
9) Fixed XP rewards for clients and extended XP bonus event to Jan 14th.
10) Fixed rewards for possessed item photos in demon homes.
11) Fixed demon photo and crucifix inversion photo in demon home. Crucifix photos work like other evidence photos in that you can only get 1 photo of an evidence type per area.
12) Fixed a bug in demon homes that would cause the demon to stay too far from the possessed item for evidence to pick it up.
13) Fixed bug where UV Prints could not be photographed if they were on specific surfaces.
14) Fixed a bug with the compass not activating.
15) Fixed a bug preventing compass activation photo rewards.
16) Fixed a bug with evidence photos that could prevent any evidence photo from being rewarded.
17) Added a short delay to speech recognition for speech alternatives now that player voices have been added.

Balancing:
1) Added more demon pathfinding nodes in Primm to make rooms more consistent.
2) Fixed Compass spinning everywhere in some demon homes
3) You can now interact with the laptop screen as a button to teleport lost equipment back to the spawn positions.
4) Spectral emitter photos now count as demon photos rather than evidence photos so the players get the higher reward for them.

notes.title: Patch 61 - build ea0.351
notes.content:
[b]Patch 61 - build ea0.351 Notes:
Default and Experimental branch[/b]

[b]Notable:[/b]
1) Added a lobby code system which replaces the friends only option.
    Lobbies can now be public or private, both joinable via lobby code.
2) Added Loadouts. Main features are:
    3 customisable loadouts that can be renamed.
    New loadout menu at the bag and shop screens.
    Quick buy from shop at the bag screen if you have enough money.
    Quick add loadout to cart at the shop screen.
3) Redesigned the computationally expensive cryptographic operations that are used for storage and retrieval of encrypted cross-session persistent variables.
    This change provides better performance mostly in the lobby UI’s.
    This change is heavily leveraged by the Loadout system.
4) Shoulder Lamp and Powerful Flashlight have been decoupled.
    The regular flashlight has been removed.
    Players get a shoulder lamp by default and can use it without carrying another flashlight.
    The Powerful Flashlight has been buffed, making it more useful for larger areas.
5) Player XP and levelling added. 
    Player XP and money don't level linearly together so there is a generic formula done to initialise XP for players who have already played. Its roughly money/2 and rounded down to the nearest 1000.
    Players must play a match to initialise their XP and levels. Until then they will appear as level 0 on leaderboards and won't be on the XP leaderboard at all.
    Added XP system and migrated all of the old reward code to it.
    This allows for a more detailed breakdown of a game back in the lobby screen and can handle more than one reward type(XP and money etc.).
    This system will be a core system needed for the new end game content coming soon.
6) XP Leaderboard
    New leaderboard added for XP and player levels are now visible.
    Player
7) XP events system added.
    Current Christmas and the New Year XP event is 2x XP until January 1st.
8) Rebuilt from scratch the cross-scene data persistence, steam achievements, and stats managing systems.
    The new systems are more scalable. This scalability will be required for the new end-game patch coming soon.
9) Hugely optimised the player object lookup speed (how the game traverses the player object hierarchy in search of sub-objects).
    This has almost completely removed the lag spike when toggling equipment on/off and swapping between items in your inventory.
    This was preventing expansion of the player tools, which will be needed for the new end game content coming soon.
    In the new system I could add 1000 new player tools right now and the performance impact would be negligible. In the old system the game would crash.

[b]Minor:[/b]
1) Fixed lobby variable persistence bugs when joining new lobbies from old ones.
2) Fixed LOD switching bugs in the starved forest house causing visual bugs on some objects.
3) Fixed demon initialization bug in Starved Forest house that made it flat and be stuck in place and caused low frame rate.
4) Fixed LOD popping issue with some gravestones in Reapers Rest.
5) Added a smaller, permanent reticle on the screen so players can find the centre of the screen easier.
6) Fixed the alarm interaction bug in Primm.
7) Fixed a bug in Primm that caused the basement and upstairs child's bedroom to be considered the same room by the demon.
8) Fixed some visual bugs in Primm, mostly on walls.
9) Fixed a bug that allowed the demon to kill players through the front door at Primm.
10) Renamed the camera keybind that takes photos to "Take Photo".
11) Sunshine Cover now gives the correct Large reward.
12) Increased player/equipment interaction reach.
13) Disabled rich text on player names in all menus.
14) Forced an order of lobby avatar assignment to prevent lobby bugs when players rejoin a lobby.
15) Fixed a logic issue that caused the front door to permalock if the possessed item was picked up during a hunt.
16) Fixed a bug where picking up and dropping interactable objects too quickly caused the script to lock and not be able to pick up any more.
17) Added some robustness to the network code for interactable objects that are not tools.
18) Reskinned the bag screen.
19) Added flashlight sound effect to shoulder lamp.
20) Added mini demon model to the altar when you submit correct evidence. This will be more useful for the new end game content coming soon.
21) Christmas decorations :)
22) Fixed LOD pop in on some objects in Bitterwind Hollow.
23) Fixed a bug that could cause players chest and head aim rigs to be stuck facing downwards when the scene loads.
24) End of round summary screen replaced.
25) Changed EMF sounds.
26) Fixed a bug that caused some UV Prints photos to not register for rewards.
27) Fixed a bug with other players lights around portals.
28) Changed LOD switch rate on floor tiles in Reapers Rest. Decreased popping at the cost of some performance.

[b]Balancing:[/b]
1) Disabled the hunt length increase modifier applied after the possessed item is picked up in the demon home. Now those hunts are normal length.
2) Fixed orbs spawning outside the possessed item room.
    Orbs now spawn closer to the centre of the possessed item room with a small random directional vector value applied.
    They can clip though walls towards the end of their life but will be in the correct room for most of it.
3) Burned crucifix' can be replaced for evidence. Inverted crucifix' can be picked up and replaced, and also used to stun demons.
4) Backpack buffed to +2 inventory slots.
5) Players are now rewarded for possessed item photos.
6) Sound Gun has a new sound wave display for evidence behind the sounds numbers.
    Players now must be in same room for sound gun to trigger the sound and sound wave display but the numbers still help players locate the demon from long range.
7) Rewards tweaked, mostly increased.
8) Added walls to Reapers Rest entry area. Players can use these for cover and for mounting equipment.
9) Items close to the portal entry are now teleported back to spawn to prevent them being locked behind the portal.

notes.title: Patch 59 - build ea0.312
notes.content:
[b]Patch 59 - build ea0.312 Notes:[/b]
[b]Default and Experimental branch[/b]

[b]Notable:[/b]
1) Added a new monitor to the van which shows your current personal rewards and how much they are worth.
    (Future plans to have randomly chosen rewards and only 4 are active per match. For now I only have 4 so it's always the same ones)

[b]Minor:[/b]
1) Added more partial key phrases to trigger speech recognition
2) Equipment  can still fall under the snow, but now you will get the prompt to pick it up if you can find it.
3) Added an empty slot in the inventory, so players can empty their hands without dropping all their tools if they want.
4) Changed Vow of Silence Buff icon to be a low volume to prevent players from thinking their prayers or radio won’t work (the old buff icon was a mute icon).
5) Equipment is now hidden with the guidebook is open.
6) Fixed a bug where having a crucifix in your inventory would prevent you from being killed even if it wasn't in your hand.
7) Fixed bug that caused inverted crucifix photos not to register for reward.
8) Added level names to level preview images on the table.
9) Replaced crucifix image in the shop.
10) Changed the scrollbar handle in the leaderboard, shop, and lobby lists screens.
11) Fixed bug that caused levitating item photos not to register for reward.
12) Fixed a bug where hunt escapes could be double counted.
13) Fixed bug that caused demon photos not to register for reward.
14) Added equipment descriptions for each item in the shop.


[b]Balancing:[/b]
1) Changed the $2000 safety net logic to only grant the money if the player also has no tools left. This prevents abuse of the system and overwriting of actual rewards earned in a game.
2) Motion sensor changed:
         Doesn't beep for players at all.
         Beep volume increased.
         Activation range increased.
         Red light added for when it activates.
         Alert added to the camera monitor that will pop up telling you a motion sensor was triggered.
3) Compass made more reliable and will only activate in the possessed item room.
4) Freezing temps via cold breath is now more common.
5) Improved the reliability of the crucifix inverting.
6) UVPrints changed:
         A print is placed every second minute for 10 minutes, 5 prints in total.
         They will spawn in order of closeness to the possessed item.
         Fixed a bug that had a chance to despawn the UV print, which was a bigger issue when there was only one.
7) Increased the range of the spectral emitter.
8) Orbs changed:
         Increased spawn frequency.
         Increased visibility.
         Decreased spawn distance from possessed item.
         Increased lifespan.
9) Increased the personal reward for escaping a hunt and taking a photo of the demon. (Escaped hunts are hunts where the demon has targeted you (you can hear the heartbeat) and you escape.)
10) Increased the range of the demon's voice when it's hunting.

notes.title: Patch 58 - build ea0.307
notes.content:
[b]Patch 58 - build ea0.307 Notes:[/b]
[b]Default and Experimental branch[/b]

[b]Notable:[/b]
1) Replaced default windows voice recognition system with Recognissimo.
    Added a custom interface layer between Recognissimo and Dissonance(voice comms system) to avoid resource contention with the microphone.
2) Added a speech alternative system for player who don't have a microphone. This can be disabled from the Controls section of the settings menu.
    It applies to the prayer book and radio.
 
[b]Minor:[/b]
1) FXAA is now the default AA method.
2) Fixed a bug where you couldn't play the tutorial more than once without restarting the game.
3) Changed thermometer display.
4) Changed sound gun display.
5) Adjusted the portal position in all maps.
6) Rebuilt some navigation mesh's for enemies.
7) Adjusted volume of multiple sound effect
8) Added lights to the radio to show when it recognises a phrase.
    Red light will show if it recognised a phrase.
    Red and green light will show together if you get a response from the demon

[b]Balancing:[/b]
1) Upgraded UVLamp.
2) Increased the chance for the radio to work.
3) very slightly reduced the speed of all enemies and demons.
4) Increased the power of all player buffs from the prayer book.
